description: Source code for the CocoPanoptic dataset class and build function, used for loading and processing COCO panoptic segmentation data.

classes.name: CocoPanoptic
classes.description: A dataset class for loading and processing COCO panoptic segmentation data, including image and mask handling, and transforming annotations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CocoPanoptic dataset with image and annotation folders, loads COCO JSON, and sorts images.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an image and its annotations/masks at a given index, applying transformations if provided.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of images in the dataset.

methods.name: get_height_and_width
methods.description: Returns the height and width of the image at a specified index.
